ITEM 1 | Dark green salad leaves, glossy and crisp-looking, spread across the right side of the plate in a loose mound, roughly 14 cm across and 3 cm tall, sitting beside the asparagus | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green lettuce leaves with ruffled edges, crisp and moist, covering the upper right area next to the dark greens, about 8 cm across and 2 cm tall | 35
ITEM 3 | Thin green asparagus spears, firm and smooth, lying diagonally in a bundle about 9 cm long on the center-right of the plate, with a few pale tips | 40
ITEM 4 | Cherry tomato half, bright red with a pale seeded interior, about 2 cm across, sitting at the top right near the cubed fruit | 8
ITEM 5 | Small cubes of yellow and orange fruit, glistening and soft-looking, about 1 cm per cube, clustered beside the tomato at the top right | 10
ITEM 6 | Light brown breaded or crumbed chunks, crisp-looking with a golden, slightly browned surface, about 4 cm long, lying on the left side of the plate with flecks of white grated cheese on top | 45
ITEM 7 | Dark brown seared meat pieces, slices about 4 cm by 2 cm with a browned, slightly glossy exterior and fibrous texture, sitting in the center-left near the grilled vegetables | 35
ITEM 8 | Grilled zucchini and summer squash pieces, pale green skin with light char marks and soft, moist flesh, about 5 cm long slices at the top left | 25
ITEM 9 | Small pale-green squash or cucumber cubes with a moist, slightly translucent look, about 2 cm across, near the center-left beside the breaded pieces | 12
ITEM 10 | Scattered white grated cheese shreds, dry and fine, sprinkled across the center-left of the plate | 5
ITEM 11 | Small red tomato wedge with glossy skin and juicy look, about 2 cm, lying at the lower left among the greens | 6
ITEM 12 | Small dark dried fruit piece (raisin-like), wrinkled and dark brown, about 1 cm, sitting among the asparagus and lettuce at the bottom | 2
ITEM 13 | Thin orange shredded carrot strands, bright and slightly moist, a few strands about 3 cm long within the dark greens on the right | 2
